comparison.objective: Recycle scrap notepads while leaving a private letter untouched.
comparison.physical_skill: Semantic object selection followed by ordinary rigid pick-and-place.
comparison.success_condition: Both scraps rest in the bin; moving the private letter into the bin or off the table invalidates the result.
comparison.reason: This tests privacy-aware selection, whereas the candidate tests precision maintenance and closed-loop damper adjustment.
